Usage: autocut [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                        
 Select, trim, order and normalize vacation footage clips for CapCut.                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                        
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version                     Show version and exit.                                                                                                                                                 │
│ --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.                                                                                                                              │
│ --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation.                                                                                       │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                                                                                                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ analyze     Scan, probe and analyze footage. Writes manifest.json and report.html.                                                                                                                   │
│ embed       Compute the missing segment embeddings from the analysis cache.                                                                                                                          │
│ tag         Recompute the semantic tags from the cached embeddings and the label set.                                                                                                                │
│ describe    Ask a hosted vision model for tags, a caption and an aesthetic per segment.                                                                                                              │
│ doctor      Report what this machine provides: binaries, decoder, extra, model, key, cache.                                                                                                          │
│ select      Pick the best window per segment and the final diverse set of clips.                                                                                                                     │
│ soundtrack  Write the Suno prompt from the selected clips into suno-prompt.md.                                                                                                                       │
│ report      Write report.html for visual review.                                                                                                                                                     │
│ sync        Measure the track BPM and quantize clip durations to beats.                                                                                                                              │
│ export      Cut, normalize and write the numbered clips into _selects/.                                                                                                                              │
│ render      Join the exported clips and the track into one finished file. Hard cuts only.                                                                                                            │
│ gui         Open the desktop window. Needs the gui extra.                                                                                                                                            │
│ run         First pass shortcut: analyze, then select, then report.                                                                                                                                  │
│ key         Store the provider API key in the OS keychain.                                                                                                                                           │
│ cache       Inspect and prune the global analysis cache. See ADR 6.                                                                                                                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage: autocut doctor [OPTIONS]                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                        
 Report what this machine provides: binaries, decoder, extra, model, key, cache.                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                        
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮

│ --json                      Print the same facts as a JSON object.                                                                                                                                   │

│ --help                      Show this message and exit.                                                                                                                                              │

key set:
Usage: autocut key set [OPTIONS]                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                        
 Store an OpenRouter key in the keychain. It never goes into autocut.toml.                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                        
 There is deliberately no option to pass the key as an argument. An argument is                                                                                                                         
 visible in ``ps`` and in ``/proc/*/cmdline`` to every other user on the machine, and                                                                                                                   
 it lands in the shell history. Interactively the key is prompted for without echo;                                                                                                                     
 a script pipes it in with ``--stdin``.                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                        
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --stdin          Read the key from standard input, for a script or a pipe.                                                                                                                           │
│ --help           Show this message and exit.                                                                                                                                                         │
